programs.name: Stemchymal
programs.plain: A company in Japan has asked regulators to approve a stem-cell treatment for SCA3 and SCA6 (filed June 24, 2026). Approval is still pending.

programs.name: VO659
programs.plain: An experimental drug given by spinal injection, aimed at the expanded genetic repeat that causes SCA3. The same study also includes SCA1 and Huntington disease. It is an early safety study in adults.
